steps.step_text: Step 3: Verify acceptance criteria: Current live strategy stops new signals, cancels resting IB orders, submits liquidation orders, waits for flat confirmation or the configured timeout defaulting to 60 seconds, and transitions to paper only after live positions are flat; on timeout, the swap enters demotion-pending state, dashboard/email/SMS notifications are sent, unfilled liquidation orders are canceled, and promotion is blocked until manual resolution.

steps.observed:
-types declares OperatorAlertChannel with 3 variants (Dashboard, Email, Sms) — the SRS-RESV-004 dashboard/email/SMS notification triad
- atp-types declares OperatorAlertEvent with the 6 required fields (demoting_strategy_id, candidate_strategy_id, channels, elapsed_seconds, timeout_seconds, observed_at_seconds) and rejects 10 forbidden broker/IB-order/vendor fields
- atp-types declares SideEffectOutcome with 3 variants (NotAttempted, Succeeded, Failed) — the observable timeout-branch side-effect outcome (a failed IB cancel / missed operator alert is recorded as Failed, not silently indistinguishable from success)
- atp-types declares HotSwapDemotionEvent with the 8 required fields (outcome, demoting_strategy_id, candidate_strategy_id, promotion_blocked, liquidation_cancel, operator_alert, demotion_pending, observed_at_seconds) and rejects 10 forbidden broker/IB-order/vendor fields
- atp-orchestrator declares port trait HotSwapLiquidationProbe with 1 method(s) (await_flat_or_timeout) — the read-only flat-vs-timeout timing authority (no mutators — the gate cannot promote through this port)
- atp-orchestrator declares port trait UnfilledOrderCanceller with 1 method(s) (cancel_unfilled_liquidation_orders) — the SRS-RESV-004 unfilled-liquidation-order cancel path (deferred IB adapter)
- atp-orchestrator declares port trait OperatorAlertSink with 1 method(s) (dispatch) — the SRS-RESV-004 dashboard/email/SMS operator-alert dispatch channel
- atp-orchestrator declares port trait HotSwapDemotionEventSink with 1 method(s) (record) — the structured demotion state-transition audit record (SRS-LOG-001 / SRS-UI-001)
- atp-orchestrator declares port trait DemotionPendingLock with 2 method(s) (state, engage) — the SyRS SYS-49c (d) durable lockout — consulted before any flat result is accepted, engaged before a refusal returns, and declares NO clearing method (clear, resolve, release, unblock, reset) — only an operator resolves a lockout
- atp-orchestrator declares port trait SignalHalt with 1 method(s) (cease_new_signals) — SyRS SYS-49b (1)
- atp-orchestrator declares port trait DemotionBrokerageControl with 2 method(s) (cancel_resting_order, submit_market_liquidation) — SyRS SYS-49b (2) and (3), and NO disconnect — a demotion must never disconnect IB
- atp-orchestrator declares port trait PaperTransition with 1 method(s) (transition_to_paper) — the SyRS SYS-49b flat-start handoff to the internal simulation engine
- atp-orchestrator declares port trait LivePositionSource with 1 method(s) (open_positions) — the fallible flat-confirmation input (an unreadable view is never an empty one)
- atp-orchestrator::resolve_demotion matches `liquidation.await_flat_or_timeout`; the HotSwapDemotionOutcome::FlatBeforeTimeout arm is the sole `HotSwapDemotionResolved` site (no alert, no cancel); the HotSwapDemotionOutcome::TimedOutDemotionPending arm cancels via `canceller.cancel_unfilled_liquidation_orders`, alerts all 3 channels via `alerts.dispatch`, records via `events.record`, emits OrderErrorCategory::HotSwapDemotionTimeout, and calls no promotion path (ERR-7)
- atp-orchestrator::complete_demotion_to_paper requires the `&HotSwapDemotionResolved` acceptance token (constructed only by the gate's flat arm) and is the crate's ONLY `paper.transition_to_paper` call site
- atp-orchestrator::execute_demotion_sequence proves live identity via `authorize_demotion` before ANY port call, then runs the SYS-49b phases in order: signals.cease_new_signals < brokerage.cancel_resting_order < brokerage.submit_market_liquidation
- crates/atp-orchestrator/src/demotion_pending_store.rs declares DemotionPendingState with 3 states (Clear, Pending, Unreadable); `read_state` collapses an unreadable store to Unreadable (never Clear), `blocks_promotion` blocks on Pending AND Unreadable, and `resolve` is the only clearing path
- cargo test -p atp-orchestrator --lib + err_7_hot_swap_demotion_timeout: PASS (timeout demotion-pending + blocked promotion + flat-arm selectivity verified)
